Select distinct molecules from document CHEMBL1123558. Join docs by chembl_id to get doc_id, then compound_records by doc_id to get molregno and compound_name, then molecule_dictionary by molregno to get chembl_id, then compound_structures by molregno to get canonical_smiles using an inner join (only include rows where canonical_smiles is available). Return chembl_id, compound_name, canonical_smiles. Sort by chembl_id, then compound_name, then canonical_smiles.
